segments.title: July
segments.text: Hello Kemps Corner! July. The monsoon is here to test everyone's willpower. Our theme is Book the Studio plus Rain Check. We bring groups in together, make it easy to come back after the summer, and take the guilt out of rainy cancellations. The plan, thankfully, brought an umbrella.

segments.title: ₹33.6L
segments.text: So, the number. Our July target for Kemps Corner is 33.6 lakh rupees. That's 30 per cent up on last July. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 18.5 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 8.06 lakh, comebacks 4.03 lakh, and everything else 3.02 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 72 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 525 leads, 268 trials, and 72 buyers, with about 27 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.
Here's where the offers come in. Five offers carry 13.2 lakh rupees, which is 39 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Team Building Without the Trust Falls
segments.text: First up, Team Building Without the Trust Falls. Offices buying ten or more memberships save twenty-five per cent each. That's 10 buyers, for 1.52 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Offices, HR and team leads; 10+ units on one invoice.

segments.title: Kitty Party, But Make It Cardio
segments.text: Next, Kitty Party, But Make It Cardio. Book out the studio for up to twelve friends, your playlist, our instructor. That's 4 buyers, for 100,000 rupees.
segments.notes: Anyone booking the studio for a private group of up to 12.

segments.title: Shy Girl Starter Pack
segments.text: Then, for the nervous newcomer, the Shy Girl Starter Pack. Start with a thirty-minute private, then join class with a trainer who already knows your name. That's 9 buyers, for 1.46 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Gone With the Wind, Back With the Rain
segments.text: Also this month, for lapsed members, Gone With the Wind, Back With the Rain. Fifteen per cent off to return, two extra freezes for flooded days, and a lane in The Amazing Race. That's 22 buyers, for 3.78 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Rain Check (Literally)
segments.text: And finally, for renewals, Rain Check, literally. Renew in July for ten per cent off and three Rain Check tokens, with classes credited back on red-alert days. That's 30 buyers, for 5.46 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, corporate and kitty party bookings open. Week two, we call everyone who left in the summer heat. Week three, the Rain Check renewal does the heavy lifting. Week four, returning members sign up for The Amazing Race.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's July at Kemps Corner. 33.6 lakh rupees, five offers, and 72 buyers to welcome. It's raining offers. Hallelujah.
